title: Receiving Missed Signal several times
body:
Recently installed xDrip+.apk version 14fecb8-2019.01.10 due to facebook forums and "positive" publicity I've reviewed, however I haven't had the best of luck with the signal between my Dexcom G6, Samsung Note 8 (recently updated to Pie), and my Galaxy wear (running Tizen, with the wearable widget app.) 

I installed today, but have had multiple "signal missed" throughout the day. I'm hoping this forum will help to guide me to the correct settings for my configuration.  I was running the Dexcom app, first with the receiver, no issues, then with the Dexcom Android app, no issues, but already I can see the benefits of this app, its way more customization and provides predictions which I have found extremely useful for hypo's. 

In the event logs, right before it drops signal, it states : "Aggressively restarting collector service due to lack of reception: backoff: 120"

Any insight/direction on solving this solution would be helpful. 

Thank you.

comments.body:
I am having also a lot of missed readings with the latest release 14fecb8-2019.01.10.
